topic: Session list rows do not name an unpinned process's log chain
detail: ListSessions shows an unpinned process's tool events, refusals and last event, but SessionInfo has no field for its chain ID (process:<pid>-<start ns>); 'orch spaces log process:<pid>' resolves the latest chain of that PID instead. A log_owner field was not added to the proto, to avoid regenerating the Go and Swift stubs while SP-040, SP-070 and SP-073 run in parallel (D-55). Add it (and show process chains in the app, SP-054) when convenient.
